title: Self-correction mid-sentence — move the appointment, do not cancel it
caller_goal: Reschedule an existing appointment after starting to say 'cancel' and correcting themselves.

script.content: I want to cancel my— no wait, actually don't cancel it, I want to MOVE my appointment to next Monday instead. Don't cancel it.

success_criteria: Acts on the caller's final corrected intent: rescheduling / moving the appointment to next Monday.
Explicitly does not cancel the appointment.
Is clear about what is confirmed — proposes / confirms a real new time rather than asserting a move that wasn't actually completed.
must_not_claim: The appointment was moved/confirmed to next Monday without an actual confirmed slot.

failure_traps.description: Cancels the appointment, acting on the abandoned first phrase instead of the corrected request.
Claims the appointment was rescheduled to next Monday without confirming an available slot.

notes: Synthetic. Barge-in / self-correction modeled at the transcript level.
